description: AI-generated packaging concepts. Only box-1 and box-3 used on website; actual packaging to be confirmed with business.

jobs.note: Refined alternate still deviates from original logo; not used on website.

params.prompt:
[SCENE]
Three-quarter portrait photograph of a closed warm-cream rectangular cookie gift box with the exact crimson logo centered and clearly visible on its top lid. A slim crimson cotton ribbon wraps near one edge, away from the logo, tied in a small natural bow. A tiny cream dessert plate with three reference alfajores sits in the foreground alongside it. Both the whole logo and the cookies are readable.
[ENVIRONMENT DETAILS]
Ivory linen tabletop, a narrow crimson and cream woven Peruvian textile corner, light textured plaster background, subtle paperboard grain. Compose box centrally with breathing room so a website crop retains the complete lid logo.
[LENS & CAMERA]
50mm lens, f/7.1, elevated three-quarter angle looking down enough to see the entire top-face logo, both logo and cookies sharp.
[PRODUCT PLACEMENT]
Use reference 1 as the EXACT original logo artwork, unchanged: smiling hat-wearing braided character above the GORDA'S GOODIES wordmark, cookie-shaped OO, deep crimson ink. Print this complete logo prominently on the TOP FACE of the box lid, flat ink following the lid's real perspective. Preserve the lettering and illustration, do not invent or redesign a logo. The brand lettering must read exactly "GORDA'S GOODIES". Reference 2 controls the actual alfajores: small scalloped pale-golden shortbread sandwiches, caramel-brown dulce de leche, powdered sugar, handmade irregularities. Reference 3 controls the warm photographic styling, not cookie shape or branding.
[HUMAN ELEMENT]
No people or hands. A gift ready to share.
[LIGHTING]
Large soft window from camera-left at 45 degrees, 5000K daylight, gentle cream bounce, soft falloff and grounded contact shadows. Keep printed logo edges and sugar highlights clear.
[ATMOSPHERE]
Intimate thoughtful homemade bakery gift, premium but achievable packaging. Believable material texture, no luxury CGI sheen.
[COLOR PALETTE]
Warm cream paperboard, crimson #a31f1f ink and cotton ribbon, natural caramel cookies, ivory linen.
[STYLE REFERENCE]
Warm tactile food storytelling, natural appetizing editorial photography, honest paper textures and restrained retouching.
[QUALITY MARKERS]
Tack-sharp commercial photography, editorial commercial standard, ultra-realistic textures and materials, professional retouching standard, no AI artifacts.
[AVOID]
no AI artifacts, no warped or smeared text, no fake words baked into the image, no plastic look, no waxy surface, no cartoonish rendering, no extra fingers, no extra limbs, no melted geometry, no doubled subjects, no oversaturated HDR, no HDR halos, no oversharpened look, no flat fluorescent lighting, no harsh on-camera flash, no generic stock photography poses, no cliché compositions, no random unrelated brand logos, no watermarks, no signatures, no AI sheen on hair or skin, no doll-like rendering, no airbrush look, no flat solid color bands, no empty rectangular areas, no dull gradient zones. No warped product label text, no garbled letters, no fake brand names, no melted typography, no doubled labels, no fictional logos. No stale stock photography aesthetic, no synthetic stock-photo look, no over-staged feeling, no unrealistically clean environments, no perfect symmetry where natural asymmetry should be, no clipart elements, no flat illustration mixed with photo, no obviously composited backgrounds. No ribbon covering the logo. No coconut cookies, macarons, floating food or dripping caramel.
resolution: 2k
